faq.a: Yes, completely free. No hidden charges, no forced enrollment. This session is about helping you — not selling you something.
30 minutes — focused, fast, and to the point. No fluff, no filler.

faq.q: Is this open to non-CS students?
faq.a: Absolutely. BCA, BBA, B.Com, B.Sc, BA — all backgrounds are welcome. We guide you based on where you are, not where you should be.

faq.q: Do I need to know coding before the session?
faq.a: Not at all. This session is perfect for complete beginners. We start from wherever you are.

faq.q: Is the session online or offline?
faq.a: Both options are available. Visit our Indore office or join via Google Meet or phone call — your choice.
